The catalytic orb is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be produced using the Crafting skill.
As with all Tier 11 items, players cannot make this armour and the robe top is only available as a boss drop from the Warped Gulega.
Although the robe itself does not have a dungeoneering requirement, It can only be obtained by fighting the Warped Gulega, thereby making 95 Dungeoneering a requirement for obtaining and wearing it.

Chocolates were one of the items found in the reward chests during the 2014 Halloween event.

Players may obtain chronotes by handing in restored artefacts to collectors or donating to the museum.
• Collections can be completed an unlimited number of times and always reward the same amount of chronotes.
• Most collectors offer chronotes for each artefact handed in, as well as a set bonus of 100% for a total 200%.
• Velucia offers a 25% larger set bonus for completed museum collections, for a total 225%.
• Individual artefacts may be donated to the museum donation bin next to the museum guard, northeast of the teleport destination of the Archaeology journal, for 40% of what would be given as part of a collection. However, the donation bin accepts artefacts without limits or restrictions. This is similar to Baby Shakes from the player-owned farm.
Completing each collection exactly once awards the player with a total of 554,464 chronotes, which is about half the amount required to buy all items in the Archaeology Guild Shop. The following table lists the collections, the level required to complete them, and the cost calculations:

The Daemonheim aura 3 was a reward for completing the easy, medium and hard Daemonheim achievements, and was given by Talsar.
The dark beast assignment token is a reward enhancer that ensures that Morvran will assign dark beasts.
When obtained, it is automatically converted into 2 charges within Wythien's enhancer management interface, where the effect can be toggled on or off.
A deathbell hood is tier 7 necromancy tank headwear available in Daemonheim as part of the deathbell armour set.
They are made from ensouled soulbell cloth and ensouled thread with level 64 Crafting.
Deathweed gloves are tier 6 necromancy tank gloves available in Daemonheim as part of the deathweed armour set.

Eclipse Enchanter hood is a head slot cosmetic override that is unlocked through the Academy of Skillers promotion from Treasure Hunter.
Elder memories are divine memories obtained from harvesting elder wisps.

Elven Top.x: The Elven Top is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Elven outfit. It is the override equivalent of the Elf-style coat and Elf-style dress top items.

sc: The festive jumper is a torso slot item that can be purchased for 2,000 Christmas spirit from the Christmas Spirit Shop.
It could originally be received from the 2013 Christmas event.
The Frozen key piece (Bandos) is dropped by any follower within Bandos's Stronghold inside the God Wars Dungeon.
The frozen key piece does not always trigger a loot beam and does not show up in area loot, so players should be careful to manually check their drops if they are attempting to obtain it.
Gallileather chaps is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
Yellow gloves can be purchased from Barker at his store Barker's Haberdashery in Canifis.
It is made by first smithing a gold bowl from 2 gold bars, granting 30 Smithing experience, and then using it on a water source.
It can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It can be created at level 87 Smithing from four gorgonite bars.
The green rectangle key is a key found in Daemonheim during the Three's Company Fremennik Saga.
Placing it requires unlocking the Furniture plans: Guthixian house portal, a reward from the Equilibrium League.
Hall of Fame walk override token (untradeable) is an unlock token that can be won from Santa's Christmas Present.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Hall of Fame walk animation override, destroying the token in the process after a confirmation prompt.

The healer's insignia is a reward from Barbarian Assault that can be purchased with 500 healer honour points if players are a level five healer and have at least five Penance King kills to use in the rewards shop.
When first received from the rewards store, it comes fully charged.
They are found in the north-west bookcase in the New Varrock palace library during Dimension of Disaster: Defender of Varrock.
They are nearly identical to the Heart magic notes obtained during Ritual of the Mahjarrat.

Hellion Legguards.x: The Hellion Legguards are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be purchased, along with the rest of the Hellion outfit, for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store. They could originally be unlocked upon purchasing the 2018 Premier Club package or the 2018 Summer Special.

Highland shirt (red).x: The red highland shirt is part of the highland outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.
